This [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''base''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tieos/Legends|Tieos]]. The [[T. Alvak's father|father]] of [[T. Alvak]] served as the senior [[Portmaster/Legends|portmaster]] of the base during his [[Navy/Legends|naval]] career.
